items.title: Liux’s Big microcar bets on sustainability to take on Chinese rivals
items.feed_excerpt: The Liux Big microcar is made in Spain. The startup thinks it can compete in a crowded market with its tiny electric car built around sustainability.

items.title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
items.feed_excerpt: Elon Musk says a secretive new SpaceX foundry will let him cast his own turbine blades and get gas power online 18 months faster than anyone else — but it's a bet on a fuel source that's already triggering lawsuits and health studies everywhere his (and others') turbines have gone in.
